description: Installation, testing, maintenance, and unclogging of pressurized potable water piping, sanitary fixtures, concealed bathroom valves, drainage lines, and water pumps.
daily_tasks: Measuring and cutting CPVC and UPVC pipes with ratchet cutters
Solvent cement jointing of water supply piping
Manual die-threading of GI steel pipes with cutting lubricant
Wrapping PTFE teflon tape clockwise on threaded joints
Mounting bib cocks, angle valves, pillars, and health faucets
Fixing ceramic washbasins, kitchen sinks, and water closets
Clearing clogged drain traps using hand auger snakes
advanced_tasks: Roughing-in concealed thermostatic shower diverters with level alignment
Hydrostatic pressure testing of plumbing manifolds at 10 bar
Installing multi-tank overhead water systems with non-return check valves
Laying 110mm SWR sewer lines with 1:50 gravity self-cleansing slope
materials: CPVC, UPVC, and GI pipes (0.5 to 2 inch)
Brass angle valves and bib cocks
work_processes: Site Measurement -> Wall Chasing -> Pipe Sizing & Cutting -> Solvent / Thread Jointing -> Concealed Valve Setting -> Pressure Leak Test -> Sanitary Fixture Trimming
troubleshooting_tasks: Locating concealed pinhole water leaks inside tiled walls
Diagnosing continuous water running in toilet flush cistern float valves
Eliminating water hammer knocking noise in high-pressure lines
Clearing mineral scale buildup in instantaneous water geyser inlets
quality_inspection: Checking zero water weepage under 10 bar hydrostatic pressure
Verifying plumb vertical and true horizontal alignment with spirit level
Ensuring drainage traps maintain a minimum 50mm water seal
Confirming smooth 90-degree lever rotation on quarter-turn ceramic valves
measurement_and_planning: Calculating water line elevation heights from finished floor level (FFL)
Planning hot and cold pipe center-to-center spacing (exactly 150mm for wall mixers)
safety_practices: Adequate ventilation when applying volatile CPVC solvent cement vapors
Wearing safety goggles during pipe cutting and wall chiseling
Precaution against sewer gas exposure (hydrogen sulfide) when clearing inspection chambers
maintenance: Draining and cleaning overhead water storage tanks periodically
Replacing degraded neoprene tap washers and O-rings
Flushing lime deposits from aerators with white vinegar
customer_communication: Explaining the durability difference between CPVC, UPVC, and PPR
Advising customers on water pump pressure booster requirements
canonical_skills: Galvanized Iron Pipe Manual Die Threading
Flush Cistern Float Valve Inspection and Leak Testing
Sewer Drainage Pipe Alignment and Clog Clearing
